newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty ends just up vs basket,depos slip from highs.
newsitem.headline: Zloty ends just up vs basket,depos slip from highs.

text.p: 1250 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 1.53/1.51 pct from the trading band centre, slightly stronger than Tuesday's close at 1.52/1.47 pct after slow sideways trade on Wednesday.
* It closed at 3.2372/75 to the dollar, flat from 3.2360/75 on Tuesday and at 1.8778/83 to the mark, down from 1.8765/77.
* O/N and T/N rates both slip to end at 23.50/24.00 after holding at the 25-pct lombard rate for most of the day as banks were short of cash at the end of the mandatory reserve period.
* Controversy around next year's budget deficit, which economists want eliminated, did not affect markets.
